instruction: Add a 'Profit' column in D with header in D1. For each week (D2:D11), calculate Sales minus COGS.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a clustered column chart on Sheet2 with title 'Sales & COGS' showing Sales and COGS data for 10 weeks in LibreOffice Calc.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc, create new sheets, insert and configure charts, set chart titles and types, select data ranges
metadata.task_rationale: Tests multi-row formula creation (subtraction) in the same spreadsheet. Harder than single SUM formula, requires filling formulas across 10 rows.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a Profit column with Sales-COGS formulas. Getter reads D1 header and D2:D11 values. Metric checks header='Profit' (0.2) and each of 10 profit values within tolerance (0.08 each, 0.8 total).

scoring_breakdown.profit_values: 0.8 - Correct Sales-COGS values in D2:D11 (0.08 each)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads D1 (header) and D2:D11 (profit values) from column D using openpyxl with data_only=True, matching the instruction requirements exactly.
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_profits') directly from the rules dict, properly handling the type='rule' framework convention.
Header check is case-insensitive and awards 0.2 points; each of 10 profit values is checked with tolerance < 1.0 for 0.08 points each (0.8 total), giving sensible partial credit.
Postconfig activates the window and saves with Ctrl+S before reading, ensuring openpyxl reads the cached computed formula values.
Complete coverage: both instruction requirements (Profit header in D1, Sales-COGS formulas in D2:D11) are verified by the evaluator.
